label: ep-engine background task
type: an asynchronous, scheduler-managed unit of work run inside the KV storage engine (warmup steps, compaction, checkpoint removal, etc.), visible via cbstats runtimes/scheduler/tasks. hasInternalComponent of monitoring:ep-engine-thread-pool - a task runs ON a thread from the pool, not independently of it.
evidence: This command provides various information about runtime statistics.
This command provides scheduler task statistics.
This command gives details on any running background tasks.
note: Promoted as a pair with monitoring:ep-engine-thread-pool per the family test: cbstats-tasks.json's own hasInternalComponent relation states the thread-pool/task containment directly, so neither concept can be fully defined without the other.
relates_to_competency_question: What is a single scheduled unit of KV-engine work called, and how does an administrator inspect running ones?
